LESSON: SAUM (FASTING)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Saum (Fasting)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Saum (Fasting), part of Devotional Acts in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: why Allah (S.W.T.) exempted some people from fasting and make presentations. Why are some people exempted from fasting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
